document.description: Identifier of the Elementor document to change. Call elementor-document-list for the documents Elementor controls.

parentElementId.description: Identifier of the element the new element is placed inside, exactly as elementor-document-get reports it. Send null, the default, to place it at the top level of the document.

index.description: Zero-based position among the destination's existing children. Send 0, the default, for first; a position past the last child places the element at the end.

elType.description: The kind of element to add. Use "container" for a layout box and "widget" for a piece of content.

widgetType.description: Which widget to add, as elementor-widget-availability reports it. Required when elType is "widget", and not accepted for any other kind.

settings.description: The new element's settings, keyed by setting name. Omit it entirely for an element with no settings of its own. A widget accepts only the settings it declares.

plan.description: The change plan to approve, including its plan token.

target.description: The concrete target that was written.

changed.description: The fields the approved plan changed.

documentDigest.description: Fingerprint of the document exactly as it is stored. Two reads of an unchanged document give the same value.

elementCount.description: How many elements the stored document holds, counting every nesting level.

maxDepth.description: How many nesting levels the stored document has. An empty document has none.

widgetTypeCounts.description: How many of each widget type the stored document holds, keyed by widget type name.
